newsitems.title: Supported VR Headsets & Social Features
newsitems.author: Bypasser
newsitems.contents: (Prototype Image from March)Hey everyone!I've seen some of you asking what VR headsets RR:ANS will support, so I wanted to go over which headsets you will be able to play the game on.STEAM FRAMERR:ANS is planned to run directly on the Steam Frame without needing a PC after release!We're also planning to support eye tracking. Players with supported eye-tracking headsets will be able to enable an option that lets other players see where their eyes are looking.This feature will be completely optional and can be disabled in settings.OCULUS RIFT & META QUESTRR:ANS supports Oculus and Meta headsets through PCVR, with controller bindings for supported devices.Please note: RR:ANS will not be available as a standalone Meta Quest game/Store Game. You will need to connect your Quest to a PC to play.HTC VIVE & VALVE INDEXHTC Vive headsets will be supported, but compatibility may be limited on some features.If you run into any issues while playing on an HTC headset, please let us know so we can work on fixing them!The Valve Index will also be supported, with controller bindings.PSVR 1 & PSVR 2 We support both PlayStation VR headsets through PCVR!PSVR 2 can connect to a PC using the right adapter and software.PSVR 1 requires additional third-party software, so support is limited.Please note: The PSVR2 needs the PSVR2 Toolkit for eye tracking.https://github.com/BnuuySolutions/PSVR2ToolkitOTHER HEADSETSOwn a headset that wasn't listed above?Other headsets, such as Bigscreen Beyond, may also work, but we can't guarantee full support at release.If you own a headset that isn't listed here, join our Discord and let us know!We want RR:ANS to support as many VR headsets as possible, and your feedback will help us make that happen.Thank you everyone for your continued support!Happy Thanksgiving and Merry Christmas!Visit our socials & Play our other gamesWishlist today: (Coming November 24th!)Play DUST: (Major Overhaul soon.)Our Steam Dev Curator: https://store.steampowered.com/developer/ThunderstormGames

newsitems.title: EVEN MORE info about the game!
newsitems.author: Bypasser
newsitems.contents: (Prototype screenshot from 5 months ago)Hey everyone, I think it’s that time again… FREE FOR ALLRR:ANS will be free on launch, free after launch, free on 1.0, free forever. And again. No microtransactions!IMPORT YOUR ROOMS AND AVATARSUsing the SDK that's coming this December, you can import rooms and they will be added straight to your account! (Avatars must be requested to be imported.)NEW OUTFITS & TIERSYou can expect a handful of new avatar items after launch. Before we talk about this, let's talk about rarities.Same as the original, but… there are new tiers.1-Star Box (Common Items)2-Star Box (Uncommon Items) 3-Star Box (Rare Items) 4-Star Box (Epic Items) 5-Star Box (Legendary Items) 6-Star Box (Exotic Items) 7-Star Box (Mythic Items) 8-Star Box (Gaming Legends Items) Now, let's get into the outfitsThe Visitors Helmet (Gaming Legends)Vocaloid Items (Still deciding on the items, possibly that one blue-haired singer..)Galaxy Raw Data set (Mythic, FREE for OG prototype testers!)& more!These will come out 2 weeks after launch, either in waves or all at once.THE WORKSHOPThe Workshop is coming to RR:ANS! Download community made ui’s, keybinds, or story mode mods.EVOLVING MAIN MENUYour main menu will change depending on what episode you’re on in the story mode. It has 5 stages:Black void (Hasn’t started story)Cracked Seam in the black void (Episode 1)God Rays shining through the crack (Episode 2)Alternate music with the crack expanding (Episode 3)The Crack bursts open and reveals…. (Episode 4)What’s done is done. (Episode 5. A field of… something beautiful.)What’s truly at the end? Is this another sick joke by them…?(Evolution Main Menu can be turned off in settings, and will set the main menu back to the original planned one.)

newsitems.title: 30K Wishlists!
newsitems.author: Bypasser
newsitems.contents: Hello mates! Baro..I meant Bypasser here!RR:ANS has hit 30K wishlists on Steam! That's truly insane.More Info on the gameRROsA New Semester will include all RROs from the original game and some new ones.I can finally use this image!Achievements(Don't mind the blank achievement images. They are unfinished.) There will probably be more when the game releases, but these are what we have right now.If you would like to submit achievement ideas, feel free to comment below, and I might add yours!TrailerA Teaser trailer will be out sometime in October. Still perfecting the lighting!This trailer will show off a couple of RROs, the Rec Center, and the UI.UITalking about UI..RR:ANS will let you customize your keybinds, change the UI, or even remove elements of the UI to make the screen less cluttered!MicrotransactionsThe game will feature no microtransactions. Ever.THE ROAD TO 1.0The launch of RR:ANS won't be perfect. Over time, this will get better.The Road to 1.0 will take a while. You can help make it faster by submitting bug reports and helping the community.Don't know how to help the community? Here are 5 things you can do to help!Making Maker Pen tutorials and SDK tutorialsTeaching new users CV3 or CV2 (or the legacy CV1)Making Inventions to help with people's gamesHelping people beat RROsMaking UI mods for people who have disabilitiesAnd giving it your Rec Room best.CHRISTMAS STARTS ON LAUNCHYou heard that right! Winter wonderland is coming early!Starting December 1st, visit the Rec Center to receive Christmas-themed launch cosmetics! (25 Days of Free Cosmetics!)That's all. See you next time!
